hypothesis: A market-wide twelve-month MarketSmith-style RS proxy plus causal RS-line, industry, price, and volume leadership may improve the return-to-drawdown and expectancy of earnings-eligible MODEL_0 signals.
iteration_disclosure: All 2017-2025 price periods and related filter results have already been inspected. Every stage is reused adaptive robustness; none is independent validation or an untouched holdout.

blocked_component.reason: No point-in-time EPS, sales, margin, estimates, ownership, or institutional-sponsorship archive is available.

market_smith_proxy.ranking_universe: Every current-archive symbol with complete signal-date and 63/126/189/252-session closes, before Stage 2 or candidate filters

feature_definitions.rs_line: signal-date adjusted stock close divided by adjusted SPY close
feature_definitions.rs_line_within_2pct_252d_high: RS line is at least 98% of its trailing 252-session maximum through the signal date
feature_definitions.industry_proxy_score: 1-99 daily rank of current-classification industry median proxy score; at least five valid members
feature_definitions.up_down_volume_ratio_50d: sum volume on positive close-change sessions divided by sum volume on negative close-change sessions; zero denominator is missing
feature_definitions.price_off_252d_high_pct: percentage below trailing 252-session adjusted closing high through the signal date
feature_definitions.rolling_beta_126: 126-session signal-date stock/SPY covariance divided by SPY variance, minimum 100 observations

execution.signal: MODEL_0 false-to-true Stage 2 eligibility transition after close
execution.entry: next available session open plus 5 bps adverse slippage

portfolio.cash_and_notional_model: Normalized R; no cash or maximum-notional constraint

decision_rule: Report all variants. With no independent validation or untouched holdout, a numeric pass remains HOLD and cannot authorize a forward specification or production change.
constraints: Apply the verified earnings blackout before filters, execution, ordering, or capacity allocation
Use only features observable through the signal date
Do not optimize thresholds after inspecting outcomes
Do not use unavailable fundamentals or silently substitute current values
Do not overwrite earlier experiments or results
Do not change production or the immutable forward journal
